paragraphs: Rav Chiyya bar Chiyya. Yuchasin did not indicate where he is found in the Talmud. Apparently it means the statement in chapter 2 of Avodah Zarah, 31a: “R. Chiyya, son of R. Chiyya bar Nachmani, said: R. Chisda said: Rav said”; some say, “R. Chisda said: Zeiri said”; and some say, “R. Chisda said: Abba bar Chama told me: thus Zeiri said, the law follows R. Eliezer.” See immediately below, and you will see that it erred.
